name: Quantum Inspire
description: Quantum Inspire is a European quantum computing platform operated by QuTech that provides free access to quantum hardware and simulators through a web interface and API. The platform supports circuit-based quantum programming in multiple languages including Qiskit, and is used as the hands-on component of TU Delft's quantum computing courses on edX. It serves as a key educational tool for the European quantum computing community.

sources.title: Quantum Hardware and Its Applications with Quantum Inspire — edX
